items.content: 起点 在时间的薄雾里，为复杂性寻找结构。 证明关心什么可以被确信；音乐与影像关心什么值得被记住。 这里收录两者之间仍在继续的工作。 爱丁堡大学数学 · 康奈尔 2025–26 交换 · 优化、形式化验证与机器检查证明 快捷入口 学术 公开版 CV 代表性工作 技术笔记 GitHub 联系我 AFFIZIEREN - HAZEZZ 00:00 / 00:00 准备音频… 去音乐页试听 CURRENT WORK 当前工作 Published in AFP 在 Isabelle/HOL 中形式化基数约束单调子模最大化的 classical greedy 与 verified stateful lazy-greedy。 AFP entry Current research 优化、network localization 与 structured nonconvexity；关注 dual collapse、structural scores 与 saddle certificates。 Research statement Formalization project Projected gradient descent 与可复用证明基础设施：projection geometry、gradient mapping、convex convergence 与 linear rates。 Project note TWO PRACTICES 两种身份，两种工作方式 ACADEMIC IDENTITY · FEIER LYU Mathematics Theorems、Isabelle/HOL 与 optimization notes：从机器检查证明到结构化非凸问题。 AFP theorem PGD formalization Technical notes CREATIVE IDENTITY · HAZEZZ Music & Image Performance、作曲与摄影系列；让舞台、声音和影像各自保留完整的叙事空间。 Music / Performance Photography / Moving Image Creative / Now Now Edinburgh · Ithaca · Chongqing —— 塑造这些工作的地方。近期在准备 bass / guitar performance videos、继续写新作品，并整理摄影与 moving-image archive。 近况更新 2026. 07 Performance videos 准备一组制作完成度更高的 bass / guitar performance videos，重点提升画面、音色、低频与整体制作质感。 Music production 继续推进新的写作、编曲与制作，把 riff、旋律、低频设计和叙事放在同一条 production line 中。 Photography archive 整理 Edinburgh、Ithaca 与 Chongqing 留下的摄影系列，以及 photography / moving image 的公开归档。

items.excerpt: A concise academic index: optimization, formal verification, OR for ML, and selected publications, formalizations, and technical notes.
items.content: Selected Work Research Statement Technical Notes Academic 学术 Feier Lyu （Fay Lyu） 我研究优化与形式化验证，尤其关注如何将算法论证分解为可复用、机器检查的结构。 子模最大化形式化 发表于 AFP（2026） Isabelle/HOL 中的一阶方法 Projected Gradient Descent 形式化项目 非凸极小极大与定位 进行中的理论研究 Selected Work Research Statement CV GitHub Academic Academic Feier Lyu (Fay Lyu) I work on optimization and formal verification, with a particular interest in how algorithmic arguments can be decomposed into reusable machine-checked structures. Formalization of submodular maximization Published in AFP (2026) First-order methods in Isabelle/HOL Projected Gradient Descent project Nonconvex minimax and localization Ongoing theoretical work Selected Work Research Statement CV GitHub THE RESEARCH LINE 结构在被转写之后如何变化？ 我的最高层问题是：数学结构在被形式化、对偶化、离散化与算法化之后如何变化。 形式化揭示 theorem dependencies 与可复用接口；对偶与不变性揭示哪些信息仍被保留；离散化则检验哪些约束在计算对象中仍有意义。 正式发表于 AFP（2026）：对基数约束单调子模最大化的 classical greedy 与 verified stateful lazy-greedy 进行形式化。 发表后扩展：当前仓库进一步发展 stochastic-greedy theorem line，包括 sampling、approximation packaging 与 oracle-cost accounting。 AFP entry Theory dependencies Submodular repository PGD repository THE RESEARCH LINE What changes when structure is transformed? My central question is how mathematical structure changes after formalization, dualization, discretization, and algorithmization. Formalization exposes theorem dependencies and reusable interfaces; duality and invariance reveal which information survives; discretization tests which constraints remain meaningful in computational objects. Published in AFP (2026): a formalization of the classical greedy algorithm and a verified stateful lazy-greedy variant for cardinality-constrained monotone submodular maximization. Post-publication extension: the current repository additionally develops a stochastic-greedy line, including sampling, approximation packaging, and oracle-cost accounting. items.title: Selected Work
items.excerpt: Selected formalizations, optimization notes, research directions, and a supporting computational prototype.
items.content: Selected Work Research Statement Technical Notes Selected Work Feier Lyu （Fay Lyu） 这一页只列可核查的学术成果、形式化项目、研究笔记与技术原型；完整的问题线与研究动机放在 Research Statement。 Selected Work Feier Lyu (Fay Lyu) This page lists verifiable academic outputs, formalization projects, research notes, and a supporting technical prototype. The broader problem framing belongs in the Research Statement. ACADEMIC WORK 学术工作 01 FORMAL VERIFICATION Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization 状态： 发表于 AFP，2026。AFP 条目覆盖 classical greedy 与 verified stateful lazy-greedy；当前仓库另含发表后的 stochastic-greedy 扩展，包括 sampling、approximation packaging 与 oracle-cost accounting。 问题： 如何在可复用的 Isabelle/HOL 框架中表达 classical greedy 与 lazy-greedy 的近似保证？ 我的贡献： 在 Wenda Li 老师指导下独立完成全部形式化，包括子模性基础设施、近似论证，以及可执行与 stateful algorithmic components。 证据： AFP Proof document GitHub DOI 02 FORMAL VERIFICATION First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL 状态： 已提交至 Archive of Formal Proofs，目前等待审核。 问题： 如何把 projection geometry、smoothness、convexity 与 telescoping argument 组织成 Isabelle/HOL 中可复用的一阶方法基础设施？ 我的贡献： 独立设计并完成全部形式化，包括 projection inequality、projected-gradient mapping、凸收敛、强凸线性收敛与 public theorem interface；该项目没有导师参与。 证据： Project page GitHub 03 OPTIMIZATION / MINIMAX LEARNING TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking 状态： Working note / exploratory theoretical work. 问题： Two-timescale value-function tracking 是否能通过 Schur-complement Hessian 支持二阶 saddle escaping？ 我的贡献： 整理 value-function viewpoint、二阶 tracking gap 与可继续检验的 theorem-level 路线。 证据： Note 04 DUALITY / INVARIANCE Duality and Structural Scoring under Invariance 状态： Ongoing theoretical work. 问题： 当 translation 或 gauge invariance 使普通对偶退化时，能否恢复与 localization instance difficulty 相关的结构证书？ 我的贡献： 推导并整理 dual collapse、Range(B)、cycle consistency、structural scores 与 saddle certificates 之间的联系。 证据： Research note Derivation history SUPPORTING TECHNICAL WORK Prototype / Computational Experiment 05 PROTOTYPE / COMPUTATIONAL EXPERIMENT Metalcore Piano Lab 状态： Supporting technical prototype / work in progress. 问题： 如何把连续的 audio / rhythm streams 转换为保留节拍、段落与可玩性约束的离散谱面？ 我的贡献： 设计并实现 browser-native 分析与谱面生成原型，包括 onset、beat-grid、section alignment 与 playability constraints。 证据： GitHub Project note ACADEMIC WORK Academic Work 01 FORMAL VERIFICATION Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization Status: Published in AFP, 2026. The AFP entry covers classical greedy and a verified stateful lazy-greedy variant; the current repository additionally contains a post-publication stochastic-greedy extension with sampling, approximation packaging, and oracle-cost accounting. Question: How can classical and lazy greedy approximation arguments be represented within a reusable Isabelle/HOL framework? My contribution: I independently completed the full formalization under the supervision of Wenda Li, including the submodularity infrastructure, approximation argument, and executable/stateful algorithmic components. Evidence: AFP Proof document GitHub DOI 02 FORMAL VERIFICATION First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL Status: Submitted to the Archive of Formal Proofs; awaiting review. Question: How can projection geometry, smoothness, convexity, and telescoping arguments be organized as reusable Isabelle/HOL infrastructure for first-order methods? My contribution: I independently designed and completed the entire formalization, including the projection inequality, projected-gradient mapping, convex convergence, strongly convex linear convergence, and the public theorem interface. This project had no supervisor. Evidence: Project page GitHub 03 OPTIMIZATION / MINIMAX LEARNING TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking Status: Working note / exploratory theoretical work. Question: Can two-timescale value-function tracking support second-order saddle escaping through the Schur-complement Hessian? My contribution: Developed the value-function viewpoint, isolated the second-order tracking gap, and organized a theorem-level route for further verification. Evidence: Note 04 DUALITY / INVARIANCE Duality and Structural Scoring under Invariance Status: Ongoing theoretical work. Question: When translation or gauge invariance collapses a standard dual, can one recover structural certificates tied to localization instance difficulty? My contribution: Developed and organized the connection among dual collapse, Range(B), cycle consistency, structural scores, and saddle certificates. Evidence: Research note Derivation history SUPPORTING TECHNICAL WORK Prototype / Computational Experiment 05 PROTOTYPE / COMPUTATIONAL EXPERIMENT Metalcore Piano Lab Status: Supporting technical prototype / work in progress. Question: How can continuous audio / rhythm streams become discrete charts while preserving beat, section, and playability constraints? My contribution: Designed and implemented the browser-native analysis and chart-generation prototype, including onset detection, beat grids, section alignment, and playability constraints. Evidence: GitHub Project note
